decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - Notwithstanding Condition 2, details in respect of the following shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Council as Local Planning Authority before the relevant work is begun. The relevant work shall be carried out in accordance with such approved details:a)	Details, including samples, of the colour of the cabling and the cameras hereby approved;b)	Details in respect of the method of fixing the cabling to the bridge (for the avoidance of doubt, details of the method of silicon fixing shall be provided, including the colour of the silicon to be used); c)	Details, including plans, of the location of the cabling;d)	Details of proposed improvements to the existing brackets to which the cameras would be attached.
description: Installation of 2 long and 2 short range cameras onto the chequer plate deck of the existing navigational lights on Kew Bridge.
